title: Closing of the interview
summary: Crouch says he is received as well in the straight world as in jazz, thanks the Stewarts and ends the recording.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Okay. And so in closing then, you have been -- you are beginning to be as well received as a bassist in the so-called straight world of music --
-- as you have been these many years in the jazz world.
Well, it looks like we've gotten to the end, Mr. and Mrs. Stewart. And I must say, I think we've got some for them to listen to and some for them to make a film to.
Thank you very much. It's been quite a pleasure.
